case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We appreciate your alternative proposals and are prepared to accept the 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms to support our long-standing partnership. Under these extended terms, we can offer a revised price of €51.60, which represents a significant step towards your position.

For our Demo Gießerei GmbH, the trust built over generations between our houses means everything to us. It is a genuine pleasure to work together on solutions that serve both of our operations for the long term. 

To confirm the full details of our current offer, we are pleased to propose a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have noted your updated proposals and appreciate the continued dialogue between our companies, building on the long relationship our foundries have shared over the years.

Our main Angebot stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To help bridge the gap, we are willing to accept the 45-day payment term, which allows us to reduce our price to €51.10. As an alternative package, we can offer a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

However, your steps are very small; we need to see a more realistic approach to reach an agreement that sustains our long-standing partnership. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, given the deep roots and long-standing partnership our companies share. Our team takes great pride in the quality we deliver from our foundry floor.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is a price of €51.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to make another concession and reduce our price to €50.80 for this package. However, your steps remain marginal, and we must ask for a more substantial move from your side to conclude this negotiation.

Alternatively, we can offer a package with a price of €50.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €50.80 per unit.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
